slides.title: EXPLAIN ANALYZE = [[query plan]]
points: Query ko kaise execute hota hai, step‑by‑step dekho
Rows ka estimate, join type, cost sab milta hai
slides.note: Bole toh: Doctor ki report jaisi, problem locate karo

slides.title: Simple query ka [[EXPLAIN]]
slides.code:
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 5;
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 5;
slides.note: MySQL 8+ ya Postgres mein use hota hai

slides.title: Plan ko kaise [[padhe]]?
points: **type**: ref = index use, ALL = full scan
slides.note: Jab rows > 1000, query ko tweak karo

slides.title: Slow query vs [[Optimized]]
slides.note: Index banane se plan badal jaata hai

slides.title: Index add karke [[speed]] badhao
slides.code:
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer ON orders(customer_id);
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 5;
slides.note: MySQL mein ALTER TABLE bhi chal sakta hai

slides.wrong: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM orders; -- WHERE missing, plan full table dikhata
slides.right: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 5; -- specific filter se index usage dikhai
slides.why: WHERE bina index ka fayda nahi dikhata, galat plan se optimization galat hota hai

points: EXPLAIN ANALYZE se **execution plan** milta hai
type, rows, Extra se bottleneck pehchano
Index ya column selection se plan improve karo
Har query ke liye plan check karna best practice
